The published `v0.1.0-rc.18` release-candidate tag is available, while the full reviewed SHA remains the stronger supply-chain default for production ([GitHub guidance](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-guides/security-hardening-for-github-actions#using-third-party-actions)).
